title: Power Apps: Form fill assistance in apps can provide suggestions for existing values
description: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to suggest updates to fields that already contain values—not just empty fields. This helps users update existing information with ease using AI-powered skills in their apps.
